releaseState: Local candidate qualified; truthful catalog and Smart Mix copy, concise metadata, complete station agent surfaces, restored OpenAPI source, Ask AI composition, and vitals repair are not deployed by this audit.

contentPurpose.evidence: The candidate directly explains the intended viewing loop: choose one of 16 curated stations and let random clips play from its 122-channel, 8,775-video catalog. It distinguishes normal station shuffle from optional browser-local Smart Mix, states that viewing needs no account or runtime API key, and accurately describes the twice-monthly cache-first catalog refresh with yt-dlp fallback.

designQuality.evidence: The restrained black TV-guide treatment is coherent, responsive, and appropriate to a lean-back utility. Purpose, primary action, reasons to trust the loop, real station previews, FAQ, and CTA form a clear hierarchy. Exact 390 and 1440 pixel checks found zero overflow and no resource errors; one project strip and one Ask AI footer are present. No template migration is warranted.

seo.evidence: The latest candidate passes all 15 homepage checks with no warnings: concise non-duplicated title, 134-character description, canonical, social metadata, two valid JSON-LD blocks, direct H1, four H2s, approximately 522 server-rendered words, and no broken internal links. Its 30-page sitemap has zero errors, redirects, or orphan candidates.

geo.evidence: Production is currently A-tier 90 because one literal {channel} catalog template fails validation. Source replaces it with all 16 real station HTML/Markdown pairs, producing 30 valid catalog surfaces, and restores the advertised OpenAPI document to the checkout. The temporary-host audit reports foreign-canonical advisories by design; the canonical-host source shape qualifies for S-tier after an authorized release.

performance.evidence: PSI Swarm completed 4/4 candidate profiles with weighted LCP 1.63 s, CLS 0, and TBT 2 ms. LCP was 4.50 s on slow 3G, 2.42 s on mid mobile, 1.43 s on fast mobile, and 301 ms on desktop. The remaining opportunity is approximately 34 KiB of unused shared JavaScript; dead fallback vitals requests were removed in favor of the existing lazy PostHog client.
